Do not cite or publish any item as a rule until its status is changed from draft to verified in this file and in docs/battery-verification.md.

source.document: NCCR Jamboree read-ahead, Section 4 (Draft clinical consistency test battery); also Section 6b of 'additional decisions for Jamboree'
source.table: CTC (Consolidated Tumor Case), column names and labels from the published NCCR metadata nccr_instances.ttl

notes: This file loads with RuleSet.from_json and with the config key constraints.file. The engine reads only the 'constraints' list and ignores every other key, so the metadata (id, family, status, source_statement) and the 'checks' and 'roadmap' sections do not change how existing rule files behave.

'constraints' are hard rules: generation repairs them and the output check counts violations of the same objects. 'checks' are probabilistic statements: they have no repair step and are compared as distributions. 'roadmap' items cannot be expressed on the single CTC table today.
Numbers quoted from the read-ahead (ALL about 90 percent five-year survival, 2 standard deviations) are check targets for the Input team to verify. They are not generation parameters.

constraints.name: cervical_carcinoma_is_female
constraints.source_statement: Sex-restricted sites: ... cervical only in females.
constraints.description: DRAFT. Carcinoma of the cervix uteri occurs only in females. Repair resamples sex, so it shifts the sex marginal slightly.

checks.name: radiation_precursor_leukemia
checks.source_statement: no radiation for the large majority of standard-risk ALL
checks.description: DRAFT. Radiation recode among precursor cell leukemias (the closest CTC group to ALL) compared with the real data. The share with 'None/Unknown' is reported. CTC has no risk group, so standard-risk ALL cannot be isolated, and 'None/Unknown' mixes no radiation with unknown.
checks.generation: No constraint. 'Large majority' has no stated cut-off. Use targets.joints on [radiationRecode, iccc2017ExtendedRecode] with a verified cross-tab.

group_values: Bone marrow transplant procedure was administered, but the type was not specified.

checks.name: survival_decreases_with_stage
checks.source_statement: survival should decrease with stage or risk group within each diagnosis
checks.description: DRAFT. Within each ICCC major group, five-year survival by Combined Summary Stage should not rise from localized to regional to distant. Reports how many groups break the order. Needs time and event columns, which exist only when the survival rule ran. The ordering of the stage labels is our reading and needs clinician confirmation. CTC has no risk group, so only stage is checked.
stage_order: Regional by both direct extension and lymph node involvement
checks.generation: No constraint. Survival is generated per group by targets.survival; to follow stage it needs group_col combinedSsPubDetailed with verified specs, which would change the survival grouping.

checks.name: five_year_survival_all
checks.source_statement: 5-year survival by diagnosis should match SEER*Stat (e.g., ALL around 90%, ...)
checks.description: DRAFT. Five-year Kaplan-Meier survival among precursor cell leukemias (closest CTC group to ALL) compared with the real data or, if none is given, with the unverified read-ahead figure. The population (age range, era) is not defined in the read-ahead and must be fixed by the Input team.

target.verification: UNVERIFIED figure quoted as 'around 90%' in the read-ahead; check target only, never a generation parameter

checks.generation: No constraint. Use targets.survival with a verified spec for this group.

roadmap.statement: testicular germ cell tumors only in males
roadmap.reason: CTC has no testis or ovary category. ICCC group Xc (gonadal germ cell tumors) mixes both sexes. Primary Site (primarySite) and histology (histologicTypeIcdO3) are CTC columns but have no published value list, so they are not generated.
roadmap.needs: A published value list for primarySite, or a testis-versus-ovary split in the ICCC variables.

roadmap.reason: Same as S1.1: no ovary category in the generated CTC variables.
roadmap.needs: A published value list for primarySite.

roadmap.statement: asparaginase and vincristine-heavy regimens with acute lymphoblastic leukemia
roadmap.reason: CTC records chemotherapy only as yes or no/unknown (rxSummChemoRecode). Drug names live in pharmacy claims (PHARM), which are a separate table.

roadmap.statement: cisplatin with germ cell tumors and hepatoblastoma
roadmap.reason: Same as S3.1: no drug names in CTC.
CTC has no neuroblastoma risk group. Only neuroblastoma overall (ICCC IVa) is available.
roadmap.needs: A risk group variable, probably from COG data (Option B).

roadmap.statement: diagnosis before COG enrollment before first chemotherapy claim before first pharmacy fill
roadmap.reason: Needs COG enrollment, claim and fill dates in four tables. CTC holds only month-from-diagnosis bins for first-course treatment.
roadmap.needs: Linked COG, MCP and PHARM tables with event dates (Option B).

roadmap.statement: central line placement near treatment start
roadmap.reason: Central line procedures are claims in MCP. CTC has no procedure dates.

roadmap.statement: no encounters, claims, or fills after date of death
roadmap.reason: Needs claim and fill dates plus a date of death. CTC has vital status but no date of death in the generated variables, and no claim tables.
roadmap.needs: Linked MCD, MCP, PHARM and CTC with dates (Option B).

roadmap.reason: Enrollment is in MCE and treatment dates are in claims. Not in CTC.
roadmap.needs: Linked MCE and claims tables (Option B).

roadmap.statement: protocol names, targeted agents, and immunotherapies appearing only in diagnosis years when they existed
roadmap.reason: Year of Diagnosis (yearOfDiagnosis) is a CTC column but has no published value list, so it is not generated. No list of which protocols and agents existed in which years exists in the project. CTC has no protocol or agent names.
roadmap.needs: A yearOfDiagnosis value list, an era table for agents, and drug-level data (PHARM).

roadmap.reason: Needs yearOfDiagnosis in the cohort. It is not generated today.
roadmap.needs: A yearOfDiagnosis value list and survival by year of diagnosis from SEER*Stat. After that this becomes a check on the CTC table.

roadmap.statement: inpatient-heavy claims during induction, tapering through maintenance
roadmap.reason: Needs claim-level utilization over time (MCD, MCP). CTC has no claims.
roadmap.needs: Claims tables with service dates (Option B).

roadmap.statement: survivorship pattern of periodic surveillance visits
roadmap.reason: Needs repeated visit data over time. Not in CTC.
roadmap.needs: Claims tables with service dates (Option B).

roadmap.statement: antiemetic and growth-factor fills clustered around chemotherapy cycles
roadmap.reason: Needs pharmacy fills and chemotherapy dates (PHARM, MCP).

roadmap.statement: cardiac diagnoses more frequent after anthracycline exposure
roadmap.reason: Needs anthracycline exposure (PHARM) and cardiac diagnoses (MCD) linked per patient. CTC has neither.
roadmap.needs: Linked PHARM, MCD and CTC (Option B).

roadmap.statement: secondary malignancies rising with time since radiation
roadmap.reason: CTC has sequence number and months from index diagnosis to tumor, but no radiation date relative to the second tumor, and only first-course radiation. The interval the statement needs cannot be formed.
roadmap.needs: Radiation Oncology (RO) dates linked to CTC (Option B), or a clinician-agreed proxy from CTC columns.
